question: In which of the following years was the Telangana Legislative Assembly established?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**2014**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Telangana Legislative Assembly** was established in the year **2014**, following the bifurcation of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Telangana became the **29th state of India** on **June 2, 2014**.
 
• The bifurcation was a result of the **Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014**, which was passed by the **Indian Parliament**.
 
• The Telangana Legislative Assembly is the **unicameral legislature** of the state of Telangana.
 
• It consists of **119 members**, who are directly elected by the people of Telangana.
 
• The first Chief Minister of Telangana was **K. Chandrashekar Rao**, who played a pivotal role in the **Telangana statehood movement**.
 
• The assembly sessions are conducted at the **Legislative Assembly Building**, located in **Hyderabad**, which is the capital of Telangana.
 
• The formation of Telangana was a significant step in recognizing the **regional identity, aspirations, and development needs** of the people in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **2012**__

 __
 
• The year **2012** marks the period during which the demand for a separate Telangana state gained significant momentum, but the state was not officially formed yet.
 
• The **Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS)**, led by **K. Chandrashekar Rao**, intensified its movement for statehood during this time.
 
 
 
• **2013**__
 __
 
• **2013** was a crucial year in the Telangana statehood movement as the **Union Cabinet** approved the creation of Telangana on **October 3, 2013**.
 
• This decision set the stage for the passage of the **Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014**.
 
 
 
• **2010**__
 
 
• The year **2010** witnessed several agitations and protests demanding the formation of Telangana as a separate state.
 
• Although discussions about the bifurcation of Andhra Pradesh were ongoing, no formal decision was made in this year.
